resolution.rationale: Upstream v0.88.0 and v0.89.0 keep goals AIR-only and upstream PR #1245 is still open, so the patch is still needed. v0.89.0 (PR #1177 custom instructions and PR #1268 session index) adds AIR_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS_CAPABILITY and sessionIndex.capabilities() to the AIR initialize capability list that the patch wraps in goalMeta(), and rewrites the docs paragraph the patch extends. Replaying the v0.87 patch conflicts in both places. In the replacement, the added and removed src/ lines are identical to the v0.87 patch. Only the surrounding context differs: it now includes the two v0.89.0 capabilities, so the unchanged goalMeta() wrapper receives the complete v0.89.0 AIR capability list. In docs, the replacement keeps the upstream sessionIndex wording and appends the non-AIR goal sentence. src/goal-extension.ts and the goal tests are unchanged. The v2 surface does not build initialize metadata or publish goals, so it is unaffected.
tests: npm run test:run -- src/tests/acp-agent.test.ts src/tests/session-index.test.ts src/tests/session-index-units.test.ts

resolution.rationale: Upstream v0.88.0 adds run_id filtering of late task_* frames before they reach AsyncTaskRuntime. The filter runs for every client, so opted-in non-AIR clients get the same protection. v0.89.0 does not change src/async-tasks.ts, src/tool-calls/background.ts or the async-task tests. The v0.87 replacement conflicts on v0.89.0 only in the docs/air-extensions.md initialize paragraph rewritten for the session index. The replacement keeps the upstream sessionIndex sentences and the non-AIR async-tasks advertisement example. Its added and removed src/ lines are identical to the v0.87 adaptation; only the diff context differs. Negotiation, the top-level async-tasks advertisement, the shared control method and the AIR-only Bash backgrounded marker behave as before.
tests: npm run test:run -- src/tests/async-tasks.test.ts src/tests/acp-agent.test.ts src/tests/native-subagents.test.ts src/tests/tool-call-contract.test.ts src/tests/incomplete-tools.test.ts

resolution.rationale: Upstream v0.89.0 still discards advisor_tool_result in toAcpNotifications and upstream PR #1247 is still open. v0.89.0 replaces the inline tool_result status with renderer.resultStatus(isError, nonExecution), which returns completed or failed for the synthetic tool_result the patch builds: it carries no nonExecution metadata, so the v2-only cancelled status cannot apply. Dispatched-tool cleanup now uses isFinalToolCallStatus, which still treats completed and failed as final. The v0.87 replacement commit replays cleanly and unchanged, and tsc passes against @anthropic-ai/sdk in v0.89.0.
